adapter_hint: INEGI Censo 2020 ITER (religion, indigenous language, Afro-descendant): python -m scripts.fetch_census.mexico --level both
language_note: The census records whether a person aged 3 or over speaks an indigenous language, not which one, so this is a yes/no split rather than a composition of languages. Which language is asked, and published in other INEGI tables, but not in this one.
ethnicity_note: Self-identification as Afro-Mexican or Afro-descendant, asked of everyone in the 2020 census. It is a single yes/no question, not a classification of the whole population, so the complement means 'did not identify as Afro-descendant' and not membership of any other group. Not comparable with other countries' ethnicity categories.
